g.text: 1. Create an empty Hash Set called seen

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Go through the array one number at a time

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. For each number, check if it's already in seen

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. If yes -> return true right away

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. If no -> add it to seen, move to next number

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. Finish with no repeat -> return false
